seasons.review_body: Aired on SBS from November 24, 2023 to January 20, 2024, My Demon ranked second on Netflix's Global Top-10 TV (Non-English) category during its run. The Straits Times awarded four stars, pointing to the on-screen chemistry between Song Kang and Kim You-jung as the show's engine. That chemistry is real and critics agreed on it; the 60-percent Rotten Tomatoes score from five critics reflects a split on whether the fantasy architecture and second-half plotting are sufficient to support a 16-episode run. The South China Morning Post's Pierce Conran was more critical, citing excessive product placement and narrative repetition. The audience score of 81 percent Popcornmeter tracks a viewer base that came for the leads and left satisfied with what the leads delivered. Average SBS broadcast ratings of 3.9 percent nationwide.

episode_reviews.title: Joining Hands With a Demon
episode_reviews.review_body: My Demon Season 1 Episode 3 'Joining Hands With a Demon' aired December 8, 2023 on SBS as the episode that formalised the central contract arrangement in a series that reached second on Netflix's Global Top-10 TV (Non-English) during its run. IMDb audiences scored the series 7.7; Rotten Tomatoes gave it 60 percent from 5 critics. NME found the show 'sizzling with chemistry, playful banter and well-timed humour.' Episode 3 is where the show's specific appeal becomes clear: the cohabitation comedy, the baseline mutual suspicion, and the lead chemistry that became the series' consensus strength all lock into their groove here. The contract signing plays as a fantasy K-drama staple given enough mutual wariness and physical comedy to avoid the formulaic ease the premise might suggest.
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The episode where the contract arrangement is formalised and the tonal dynamic between the two leads locks into its groove. Episode 3 is where the show’s specific charms come clear, with the comedy of cohabitation, the underlying stakes, and the chemistry that becomes the series’ spine.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The contract signing - a fantasy K-drama staple executed here with enough mutual suspicion and physical comedy to feel less formulaic than it should.

episode_reviews.title: Our Personal Heaven
episode_reviews.review_body: My Demon Season 1 Episode 16 'Our Personal Heaven' aired January 20, 2024 on SBS as the finale of a 16-episode run that averaged 3.9 percent nationwide broadcast ratings and ranked second on Netflix's Global Top-10 TV (Non-English) during its streaming window. IMDb audiences scored the series 7.7; Rotten Tomatoes gave it 60 percent from 5 critics. The South China Morning Post had flagged narrative repetition as a series weakness; the finale's resolution of the demon's centuries-long arc is the element Song Kang and Kim You-jung carry across whatever structural limitations the writing left unaddressed. The episode delivers emotional closure for the central relationship without fully overcoming the mid-series pacing issues critics noted - a satisfying conclusion for viewers who came for the leads and stayed for their chemistry.
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale resolves the fantasy mechanics and the romance arc simultaneously. It proves satisfying for those who stayed, but it does not overcome mid-series pacing issues and structural debts. Still, it delivers emotional closure for the central relationship, making the story feel complete.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The resolution of the demon's centuries-long arc - whether what he gains compensates for what the contract began - is the question the finale answers.
